assessment_summary: The proof correctly bounds the maximum number of days the process can last. It first establishes that an apartment can fight at most once in any 15-day period because it drops to at most 1 person after fighting and gains at most 1 person per subsequent fight. It then shows that for k fights to occur, the k fighting apartments must have started with at least 15-(k-1), 15-(k-2), ..., 15 people respectively. Applying this to k=1...15 simultaneously means the initial populations sorted descending must satisfy a_k >= 16-k for all k=1...15, which sums to 120, contradicting the 119 people total. The 14-day tight bound construction is also completely valid.
